data.body: **[P2] Preserve deeply nested custom-renderable records.** Although traversal above is iterative, `deepcopy()` recursively descends built-in containers. A deeply nested transform result that a custom exporter can handle therefore raises `RecursionError` and silently skips even a terminal record; the prior synchronous path passed it through when no size limit was configured. Clone the container graph iteratively while preserving aliases/cycles, and add a nesting-beyond-recursion-limit regression.
